root_goal: Evidence-complete pre-implementation research for RICON on Arma Reforger

q_000.text: Does the combined evidence justify beginning implementation under the approved constraints?
q_000.answer: Not yet: static engine, legal, physics, scale, and cross-agent gaps remain.

q_001.text: Are product scope, source-of-truth artifacts, versions, and prohibited actions complete and internally consistent?
q_001.answer: Yes for the current static phase: plan v5 and owner constraints are recorded; runtime and external voice are prohibited.

q_002.text: Which public VoN delivery/radio controls exist, and which authority and replication semantics still require source or runtime proof?
q_002.answer: Capture, method, one transmit radio, frequency, range, mute, key, power, and multiple-transceiver APIs exist; behavior is untested.

q_003.text: Can a normal Workshop mod dynamically bind RICON per-link quality to audible VoN effects?
q_003.answer: ACP/signals are extensible in principle, but no VoN per-pair binding has been found.

q_004.text: What do RelayTransceiver and IntercomTransceiver actually do, and can they satisfy leak-free radio-network relay semantics?
q_004.answer: Only type existence and inherited methods are confirmed.

q_005.text: What replication, JIP, streaming, authority, and lifecycle primitives constrain the server-authoritative design?
q_005.answer: Rpl/RPC primitives exist, but streaming relevance and dedicated/client split create unresolved radio-state risks.

q_006.text: What is the supported no-Play Workbench addon structure, compilation workflow, and source/resource visibility once game data finishes installing?
q_006.answer: Official setup requires game data; current install is incomplete. Static docs are available.

q_007.text: Do official EULAs or written permissions allow any scoped reverse engineering, given Bohemia's published prohibition?
q_007.answer: Current official usage rules prohibit reverse engineering; a stronger specific permission or legal basis has not been found.

q_008.text: Which HDSP formulas and calibration claims have primary-source provenance and sufficient validation evidence?

q_009.text: What architecture and budgets can plausibly support 30-player acceptance and 60-player stress?
q_009.answer: Rpl streaming has explicit performance warnings; no measured budget exists.

q_010.text: Are the common core contracts and extension registries sufficient for radio, infrastructure, and later cellular use without core rewrites?

q_011.text: Which checks are allowed now, and what remains blocked?
q_011.answer: Local/web reading, static artifacts, host oracles, and later Workbench compile are allowed; runtime, autotests, server, audio, BattlEye, and multi-client evidence are blocked.

q_012.text: Are M3a subscriber, attach, SMS, service-code, and M3b voice/handover semantics complete, private, bounded, and testable?

q_013.text: What can be learned from TFAR, ACRE2, Coalition VON, and Lima Charlie without copying incompatible or unlicensed code?

q_014.text: Are packaging, versioning, update compatibility, rollback, observability, and operational support requirements complete?
q_014.answer: Workshop publication/version-retention and rights requirements are known; build/rollback details remain incomplete.

q_015.text: Do the independent Claude and Codex research corpora cover every plan section with adequate source quality and no unresolved contradiction?

q_016.text: Can script-set entity/global audio signals reach the vanilla VoN SoundComponent for a specific received transmission?

q_017.text: Can a Workshop addon safely override or extend vanilla VON ACP/SIG resources without global conflicts?

q_018.text: How does the absence of BaseSoundComponent on dedicated servers constrain policy/audio ownership?

q_019.text: How can far-radio participants remain relevant without globally forcing expensive Rpl streaming?

q_020.text: Which state belongs in owner-only snapshots versus replicated entities or RPCs for JIP-safe radio lifecycle?

q_021.text: Does the current Arma Reforger Tools EULA or explicit written Bohemia permission create a narrow lawful RE exception?
